question: On which lunar days should one begin and on which release the weapon?
premises: Nandā days are specified for beginning.
Riktā days are specified for release.
The weapon is the object of both actions.
inference: One should begin on nandā days and release the weapon on riktā days.
uncertainties: Legacy hint glossed astraṃ as cloth; ritual context suggests weapon.
plain_english: One should undertake the rite on nandā days and release the weapon on riktā days.
